items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday or Thursday; week-to-week and not expected to play Week 5 in London vs JAX per Rapoport alignment. Tank Bigsby also out/IR, elevating Will Shipley as lead back with Dameon Pierce signed.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs after Week 4 hamstring exit; Rapoport week-to-week not long-term.
items.implication: Eagles backfield volume to Shipley (and Pierce) short-term; monitor Smith hamstring too for pass-game.
items.opportunity: Lead RB snaps/carries/routes for Shipley vs JAX; reverse if Barkley unexpectedly active.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) DNP Wednesday and Thursday; Friday practice looms large for Sunday night availability at ATL. Huntley would start if out.
items.why: Ankle sprain from Week 4; consecutive DNPs, coach notes treatment but decision later in week.
items.implication: Ravens offense/skill upside (Flowers/Likely/Andrews) hinges on Lamar; Huntley downgrade if out.
items.opportunity: If OUT, stream Huntley or fade BAL stack; monitor Flowers limited foot.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore did not practice Thursday due to shoulder injury.
items.why: Shoulder; missed Thursday practice ahead of MNF vs LAR.
items.implication: BUF WR depth/targets if limited or out; monitor full Friday report.
items.opportunity: Potential target bump to other Bills pass-catchers.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot) no practice again Thursday (consecutive DNPs after aggravating in Week 4); week-to-week/day-to-day, looking doubtful vs DEN.
items.why: Foot injury pulled in Q3 Week 4; two straight DNPs, Harbaugh week-to-week.
items.implication: LAC pass volume to Johnston/Harris/others; Herbert protection also thin with OT Alt expected out.
items.opportunity: Route/target share boost for Quentin Johnston and remaining WRs if McConkey inactive.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice again Thursday alongside Barkley.
items.implication: PHI pass game thinner with Barkley out too; Wicks limited hamstring also.
items.opportunity: If OUT, more targets to remaining Eagles WRs/TE Goedert (limited knee).

items.text: Berry loves Chase Brown @ MIA (RB5); Jaylen Warren vs IND (RB12) if Rico Dowdle OUT; Braelon Allen top-20 if Breece Hall out; keeping open on Bucky Irving as RB15.
items.why: Workload + defenses carved by RBs; Hall out elevates Allen; Dowdle status for Warren; open post tough week for Bucky.
items.implication: RB starters/FLEX locks in those scenarios; monitor Hall/Dowdle finals.
items.opportunity: Snap/carry/target share expansion with teammate absences.
items.conflict: Levitan xFP shows Chase Brown underperforming opportunities so far.

items.text: First Week 5 projections live: DET-ARZ shaping up as one of the most popular DFS game stacks (total 54.5, no other >45.5) due to slate context and pricing; will update continuously.
items.why: Highest main-slate total by far; pace/volume expected.
items.implication: Stack Gibbs/St. Brown/Jamo or ARI side (Harrison/Wilson) heavily in DFS/season-long upside.
items.opportunity: High snap/pace environment per Thorman; red-zone and volume spikes.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr. aggravated foot (plantar fasciitis) injury; coach says will miss multiple weeks.
items.why: Re-aggravation of plantar fasciitis; multi-week absence confirmed.
items.implication: PIT WR targets consolidate to Metcalf/others; Pittman stash only.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/route/target share for DK Metcalf and Steelers WRs.

items.text: Adam Levitan and Evan Silva: 'I think it’s gonna be the Will Shipley show against Jacksonville' after Barkley/Bigsby injuries; Eagles RB room discussion in Team-by-Team/ recap.
items.why: Barkley hamstring week-to-week + Bigsby IR; Shipley last healthy back, pass-catching profile fits.
items.implication: Short-term RB2/FLEX volume vs JAX (who allow RB targets); 1-2 week window possible.
items.opportunity: Carries + routes/targets in pass-heavy PHI script; handcuff value elevated.
items.conflict: Tough JAX run D and PHI OL issues may cap efficiency.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Nico Collins vs TEN as his WR8; volume including red-zone plus Titans struggles vs WRs.
items.why: Target-hog volume and matchup gift vs TEN.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high floor/ceiling in PPR.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/RZ share stable post any prior absences.

items.text: Berry loves Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10), Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15), Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5) for volume/matchup/coverage reasons.
items.why: Target volume + RZ for Wilson; coverage/positional weaknesses for Watson/Likely.
items.implication: WR2/3 and TE1 upside starts; Likely especially if Lamar plays or even without.

items.text: Berry hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41) and Mark Andrews @ ATL (TE17) due to tough matchups, thin roles, usage numbers; Addison injury wrinkle.
items.why: Tough matchups, limited roles, poor usage metrics.
items.implication: Sit/fade in most formats this week.

items.text: Thorman Week 5 Snaps & Pace: DET @ ARI up in pace (diamond high-total 54.5, high snaps/points history); SF @ SEA slow-paced slogs. Full rankings live.
items.why: Projected combined plays/points; DET offense/defense extremes favor volume.
items.implication: Prioritize DET-ARI players for volume; temper SF-SEA expectations.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/route/carry shares in up-tempo DET-ARI.

items.text: Bijan Robinson and Kyren Williams performing well above expected fantasy points on opportunities so far; Ashton Jeanty and Chase Brown underperforming on theirs. Sortable xFP data available to subscribers.
items.why: Expected vs actual FP analysis through four weeks.
items.implication: Sustain/regression watch: Bijan/Kyren efficiency positive; Jeanty/Chase Brown may have positive regression if volume holds.
items.opportunity: Trust volume + efficiency for Bijan/Kyren; monitor role for underperformers.
items.conflict: Berry loves Chase Brown RB5 this week despite under xFP.
